verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because a developer platform could ship a built-in assistant in its console or docs that users hand tasks to. The evidence instead describes an API for building voice agents for your own callers, through function calling, multi-agent handoff and reusable configs. The dg CLI's MCP server serves external AI coding tools rather than being an assistant inside Deepgram. Nothing shows a built-in assistant that the user can delegate tasks to within the product.
